interpretation: Descriptive summaries of existing saved windows; clean-derived pseudo-targets, not verified phoneme truth. No confidence intervals.

weighting.macro: Equal weight per group with eligible tokens.
weighting.pooled: Equal weight per eligible token; not frame-weighted.
weighting.paired: Subtract matched condition means within each group, then average groups.

indexing_audit.note: interval_mismatch fields audit the original seconds conversion against source integers; CSV mismatch fields audit actual saved lengths.
